shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && git diff -- package.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx; do echo "$f"; cat "$f"; done; rg --files . -g '"'"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx && rg -n 'export const (instant|dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)|experimental:|dynamicIO' app next.config.ts || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short --branch && git diff -- tsconfig.json && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from \"node:assert/strict\"; const url = \"http://localhost:3100/preview\"; const titles = [\"Alpha draft\", \"Beta draft\"]; const responses = await Promise.all(titles.map(async (title) => { const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { cookie: "'`draft-title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}` } }); assert.equal(response.status, 200); return response.text(); })); for (let i = 0; i < titles.length; i++) { assert.ok(responses[i].includes(titles[i]), `missing ${titles[i]}`); assert.ok(!responses[i].includes(titles[1 - i]), `leaked ${titles[1 - i]}`); } const news = await fetch("http://localhost:3100/news"); assert.equal(news.status, 200); assert.ok((await news.text()).includes("City council approves new park")); console.log("Production smoke test passed: distinct preview cookies and newsroom feed.");'"' "
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short --branch && git diff --check && rg -n 'export const instant\\s*=\\s*false|export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)\\s*=' app || true && git diff --stat"
